Overview of South Jeolla Region (전라남도)

South Jeolla Region (전라남도) is located in the South Jeolla region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Muan. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Suncheonman Bay National Garden & Wetlands, Yeosu Night Sea & Odongdo, Boseong Green Tea Fields, Damyang Juknokwon Bamboo Forest.

RegionSouth Jeolla
Capital cityMuan
Cities & municipalities48
Primary transport hubMuan Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to South Jeolla Region

KTX to Yeosu Expo, Suncheon and Mokpo stations. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in South Jeolla

When visiting cities across South Jeolla, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Yeosu Gejang (marinated crab)
  • Boseong green tea dishes
  • Suncheon cockle bibimbap (Kkomak)
  • Damyang tteokgalbi & bamboo rice

Best time to visit South Jeolla

Best time to visit South Jeolla: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov.
